title: Auto-Research Agent on MSA Organization to Improve Protein-Protein Complex Structure Prediction
title_zh: MSA 组织上的自动研究智能体以改进蛋白质复合物结构预测

paragraphs.en: 自治智能体通过假设驱动的MSA重组与迭代优化，显著提升AF3蛋白质复合物结构预测精度。 Protein-complex structure prediction with AlphaFold 3 depends on MSA content, depth, and cross-chain pairing. Current pipelines apply uniform recipes, typically maximizing depth and pairing by species, yet even whether cross-chain pairing helps AF3 remains contested. We show that the value of both depth and pairing is strongly target-dependent, so no single recipe is optimal across interfaces. We introduce an autonomous agent that treats a frozen AF3 as a black-box experimental instrument. For each target, the agent formulates biological hypotheses, analyzes and reorganizes the MSA, and iteratively refines sequence selection and pairing using predictor label-free signals alone. On 1{,}015 protein--protein interfaces from three benchmarks released after AF3's training cutoff, the agent improves overall interface DockQ over AF3's default pipeline and fixed MSA recipes on every benchmark, while using on average 60\% fewer MSA sequences than the default. Gains are largest for inter-species heteromers, where species-based pairing is unreliable: mean DockQ increases from 0.465 to 0.612 on FoldBench and from 0.482 to 0.562 on HD439. The improvements arise from both sequence construction and pairing policy, including deliberate non-pairing.These results recast MSA design as a target-specific problem and show that an autonomous agent can adapt it at test time through biological reasoning and self-directed, confidence-guided experimentation.
paragraphs.zh: 自治智能体通过假设驱动的MSA重组与迭代优化，显著提升AF3蛋白质复合物结构预测精度。用AlphaFold 3进行蛋白质复合物结构预测依赖于MSA的内容、深度与跨链配对。 现有流程采用统一的配方，通常按物种最大化深度与配对，然而即便跨链配对是否对AF3有益仍存在争议。 我们证明深度与配对的价值都强烈依赖于具体目标，因此没有任何单一配方能在所有界面上都是最优的。 我们引入一个自治智能体，它把冻结的AF3当作一个黑盒实验仪器来使用。 对于每个目标，该智能体提出生物学假设，分析并重组MSA，并仅利用预测器的无标签信号迭代地优化序列选择与配对。 在来自AF3训练截止日期之后发布的三个基准的1{,}015个蛋白质—蛋白质界面上，该智能体在所有基准上均将整体界面DockQ提升至超过AF3的默认流程和固定MSA配方，同时平均使用的MSA序列数量比默认少60\%。 增益在跨物种异源聚体上最大，而基于物种的配对在这类目标上并不可靠：FoldBench上的平均DockQ从0.465提升至0.612，HD439上从0.482提升至0.562。 这些提升既来自序列构建，也来自配对策略，包括有意的不配对。这些结果将MSA设计重构为一个目标特异性问题，并表明自治智能体能够在测试时通过生物学推理和自主的、由置信度引导的实验对其进行适配。
